steps.domain_action: Initialize the system with an odd integer n before any congruence or factorization is applied.
Propagate the factorization data of n forward into the search space for candidate r values.
Fork the candidate r into a T-arm of potentially valid values and an F-arm of potentially invalid values.
Evaluate the T-arm by checking r ≡ 3 (mod 4) and the existence of a divisor of n(n+r)/4 congruent to -1 (mod r).
Evaluate the F-arm by confirming the failure of the congruence or divisor condition.
Hold any candidate r that simultaneously satisfies and violates the conditions as a paradice state.
Join the T-arm and F-arm evaluations into a single verdict on the candidate r.
Chain the verdict on r to the next candidate in the ordered search for the least valid r.
Reverse from the current candidate r back to the divisor check on n(n+r)/4 to validate the modular condition.
Self-reference the structural consistency where n's factorization data determines its own critical r.
Permanently record the least valid r assigned to n as an append-only fixed point.
Anchor the system at the completed assignment of the least valid r to n, closing the evaluation.
